scope: Increase the GitHub STRICT regression job timeout from 10 to 20 minutes.
riskAnalysis: Two hosted jobs exhausted ten minutes without a test failure in either available log. A longer upper bound permits full verification and increases possible GitHub runner minutes only for long runs.

threatModel.assets: GitHub Actions minutes and release confidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Only GitHub's test job timeout changes.
threatModel.abuseCases: Unbounded CI hangs or bypassed tests.
threatModel.mitigations: Keep the job finite, cancel superseded jobs, and keep the full test selection.

defects.rootCause: The ten-minute hosted limit was exhausted twice.
defects.detectionGap: Canceled jobs reported no full-suite outcome.
defects.regression: A new exact-release STRICT job must finish under its revised deadline.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use cancellation timing and actual test output to distinguish test failures from runner deadlines.

rollback: Revert the CI timeout change if necessary. The previous verified development deployment remains available.

negativePaths.malformed-response: CI inputs and trace checks remain unchanged.
negativePaths.stale-state: The release lock is regenerated for the exact runtime.
negativePaths.cancellation: The GitHub job remains time bounded.
negativePaths.api-outage: No inference is invoked by CI.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Paid engineering and Vercel settings are unaffected.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Canceled checks cannot qualify a release.

proactiveReview.architecture: Change only the existing hosted job deadline.
proactiveReview.threats: Timeout remains finite and no checks are dropped.
proactiveReview.failureModes: A stuck job can consume additional runner time until canceled.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Retain all existing STRICT fault profiles.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Auditor to verify the workflow and lock.
proactiveReview.recovery: Use captured CI logs and existing job cancellation.
proactiveReview.readiness: Requires successful exact-release CI and Preview checks.
